videos.title: Kendall Jenner: "This Trick Stopped My Negative Self-Talk" (You Can Do It Too)
videos.description:
Kendall Jenner was 23, at the top of her industry, and being told that if she slowed down she'd be forgotten in six months.

She said no anyway.

In this clip, Kendall Jenner and Jay Shetty talk about the five years she spent saying yes to everything because she felt too grateful to refuse, and the moment she realised one more step would have cost her herself.

Kendall opens up about the people around her who didn't want her to stop, the photo of herself as a little girl that now sits on her bathroom mirror, and what she calls her higher goddess.

Learn about the one thing she used to value that she doesn't anymore, and why her happiest day in months was one she spent almost entirely alone.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

videos.title: Why More Freedom Is Making You Miserable
videos.description:

Kierkegaard was a depressed, heartbroken Danish philosopher who fumbled his fiancée, got destroyed by tabloids, and spent the rest of his life writing about commitment with an intensity that only a guy who completely failed at it could pull off. We dig into his core idea that the self is built through the commitments you choose to make. We talk about anxiety as "the dizziness of too much freedom," how mass media creates groupthink and kills individuality, and the modern cultural forces that have quietly engineered an entire decade of your life where commitment became optional.

CHAPTERS
00:00:00 The Commitment We're Making to You
00:00:49 The Problem: Too Much Potential, Not Enough Direction
00:05:45 Kierkegaard's Crisis: The Engagement He Couldn't Keep
00:12:32 The Tension Between Infinite Potential and Finite Reality
00:21:03 Anxiety as the Dizziness of Freedom
00:23:02 The Cold Pool Metaphor: Why Commitment Feels Like Liberation
00:31:23 Ten Ways We Avoid Making Decisions
00:41:20 The Media Environment That Makes Commitment Impossible
00:52:25 Cultural Forces Engineering Indecision
01:02:41 The Three Stages of Commitment: A Roadmap Out
